description: Deterministic release-gate contract for the PetTripFinder Pittsburgh market through PTF-PITTSBURGH-PASS3-DECISION-APPLICATION-001A.

deployment_authorization.means: A passing contract is structural only; it is not a deployment authorization. 58 of this market's 96 confirmed identities remain unresolved; navigation and sitemap remain disabled and no founder deployment decision exists.

identity_census.note: 96 canonical identities from the fea73de revalidation of the PTF-PITTSBURGH-MARKET-BUILD-001 factory (113 candidates = 96 canonical + 2 confirmed duplicates + 15 boundary exclusions), with the PGH-P1-D003 founder rename applied: Distrikt Hotel Pittsburgh is now Joinery Hotel Pittsburgh (same address and phone, old URL 301s to joineryhotel.com), still unresolved for policy. The census policy_state column is legacy-frozen at POLICY_NOT_VERIFIED (the Cleveland precedent); the final partition and the policy/exclusion authorities are the publication truth.

reconciliation.note: Pittsburgh Pass 3 applied five founder decisions: three artifact-backed publications and two explicit first-party refusals. Sunnyledge remains unresolved for RECAPTURE_REQUIRED. The final partition mechanically derives all counts.

reconciliation_cross_checks.note: The committed final partition is the disposition authority the Pass 1 application rebuilt through its builder; its count is the same 96-identity universe the census commits.

policy_package.note: The verified hotel identities are DERIVED from this package at assembly time via scripts.pettripfinder.site_data.verified_public_hotels(); they are not restated here. Every record is Schema 1.2, founder-approved against its final record_hash and evidence_hash, and backed by PUBLICATION_GRADE_EVIDENCE (rendered HTML or operator screenshot, SHA-256 bound; raw bytes live in the gitignored operator-evidence tree). Fee-contradicted/ambiguous records (EVEN Hotel, The Westin, Hotel Indigo East Liberty, Residence Inn Oakland/University Place) publish their supported non-fee facts with pet_fee withheld SOURCE_CONTRADICTORY or SOURCE_AMBIGUOUS. Hilton Garden Inn Pittsburgh Airport publishes with species withheld SOURCE_AMBIGUOUS rather than inherited from its sibling HGI properties.

public_surface.held_hotel_exclusion: Every seed hotel this market owns that is absent from the committed package (not-published seed hotels: held/manual-review plus rows still pending evidence) must have NO public route and NO reference on any surface: hotel profiles, the hotels listing/category page, nearby-lodging cards on any page, the policy-comparison table, the sitemap, canonicals, internal links, and /go/ interstitials. This market currently holds none -- every seed row it owns is published -- and the gate is derived, so it starts enforcing the moment that changes.

routes.note: route_mode market_prefixed: this market's hub, corridor, and policy-comparison pages live under /pet-friendly-hotels/pittsburgh-pa/. Pass 1 published inventory in downtown, strip-lawrenceville, and green-tree; Pass 2 added robinson, airport, and east-end/oakland-adjacent coverage, bringing published corridors to six of fifteen configured. The market and its corridors remain hidden from navigation and the sitemap (show_in_navigation=false, show_in_sitemap=false).

publish.note: The publish root must contain ONLY the static website plus the two Netlify control files. Build-internal reports the generator emits (_build_report.json, _broken_link_report.json, _quality_report.json, bundle_manifest.json) are read for gating but are excluded from site/ and must never ship.
